overview: Segmented Control switches the scope or the view of the same content between exactly two options. It calls `onChange` with the chosen index; the screen updates the content.

default.title: Default
default.text: Pass the two options in `options`, the selected one in `selectedIndex` (0 or 1) and update it in `onChange`. The control is as wide as its options.

withIcon.title: With icon
withIcon.text: Add `icon` to an option to show a 16px icon before the label. The icon takes the label color (primary, white on the selected option); pass it without its own color or size.

withCount.title: With counter
withCount.text: Add `count` to an option to show a small count Badge after the label: Primary on the unselected option, Primary Inverse (white with a primary number) on the selected one. Above 99 it shows `99+`.

longLabels.title: Long labels
longLabels.text: Labels stay on one line. When the control is wider than its container, it stops at the container width and the labels are cut with an ellipsis; screen readers still read the full label.

whiteBackground.title: White background
whiteBackground.text: Pass `background="white"` when the control sits on a light up surface, like a card or a hero, where the default light up background would disappear. Hover and focus are the same on both backgrounds.

disabled.title: Disabled
disabled.text: Pass `disabled` to disable the whole control: the selection stays visible in gray, no option can be chosen and `onChange` is not called. When the switch makes no sense for the person, do not render the control.

api.intro: Segmented Control renders the two options; the screen keeps the selection and updates the content.
api.options: The two options, in order: `label`, an optional `icon` and an optional `count`. Exactly two are drawn; extra items are ignored.
api.selectedIndex: Index of the selected option, 0 or 1. Any other value selects the first option.
api.onChange: Called with the index of the option chosen by click or arrow key. Not called when the selected option is clicked.
api.background: Background of the control: `default` (light up), for white screens, or `white`, for light up surfaces like cards and heros. Default `default`.
api.disabled: Disables the whole control: the options are disabled buttons, the group gets `aria-disabled`, and `onChange` is not called. Default `false`.
api.ariaLabel: Name of the control for screen readers, like "Scope" or "View".
api.className: Class on the control. `ref` and the other attributes go to the control element.

platforms.text: The same component exists in the iOS and Android libraries.

tokens.intro: The table below lists the Ocean tokens used by Segmented Control.
tokens.blocks: The counter is a small [Badge](docs:components-badge--docs); its size tokens are listed there.

rules: Use exactly two options; with more, use Tab or the Filter Bar.
Keep `selectedIndex` in the screen state and update it in `onChange`.
One option is always selected; there is no empty state.
Use `background="white"` on light up surfaces (cards, heros); keep the default on white screens.
Use `disabled` only when the switch exists but is unavailable for now; when it makes no sense for the person, do not render the control. There is no loading state.
Pass `aria-label` with what the options switch.
Pass icons without color or size; the control sets 16px and the label color.
Do not use the control to filter a list or to turn a setting on or off.
